notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/5dddc34dfc6a4ae99570122f0d3dadc984554ebd.jpg[/img]
We’re thrilled to announce a new and exciting feature for our community—starting today, the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is live! Whether you’re a competitor or a fan, this calendar is your place for staying up to date with every exciting event in our competitive gaming scene.

Access the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar]here[/url]!

[h2]Why We’re Introducing the Public Tournament Calendar[/h2]
As the esports scene continues to grow, we’ve noticed the demand for a centralized place where all tournament schedules are readily available and shared well in advance. We understand that keeping track of multiple events across multiple platforms can be overwhelming.

That’s why we’re making it easier for everyone to stay in the loop – whether you’re a seasoned pro or a dedicated fan.

[h2]What does the calendar include?[/h2]
The calendar will include World’s Edge sponsored tournaments for:
[list][*] [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
Be aware that some of the information displayed in the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is incomplete right now, to let the tournament host share more information with you at their own pace. All of the information displays what we can share at this moment and is [u][b]subject to change[/b][/u].

[h2]Stay Connected![/h2]
With the launch of this new feature, we’re taking another step towards fostering a more connected and informed esports community. Whether you’re a competitor looking to plan your next big challenge or a fan eager to follow your favorite player or teams, this calendar will be your go-to source for all things esports.

We’re incredibly excited to roll this out and make esports even more accessible. Stay tuned for further updates and new features that will make following and participating in the esports scene easier than ever!

See you at the tournaments!

The Red Bull Wololo tournament is [b]back[/b] in 2024 with [b]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/b] – when new legends will soon be forged through the fires of competition. Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will take place at Castillo de Almodóvar del Río in Spain – summoning the fiercest Age of Empires champions to challenge the reigning kings of the castle for their crown.

All are welcome to test their mettle – from seasoned veterans to those who wish to try their luck in a tournament for the very first time.

Plus, with over twenty-five years of legendary battles in the Age of Empires franchise, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will comprise of four titles in which competitors will be able to prove themselves worthy:
[list][*] [i]Age of Empires[/i] – Played using [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Return of Rome[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
[b]This year, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will also tread the land of gods, legends and mythical beings in the first-ever competition in [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i].[/b]

[b]The qualification trials will soon commence[/b], allowing fearless contenders the chance to enter through the mighty castle gates at Castillo de Almodóvar del Río. Those who succeed will join us for the main event starting on [b]October 3rd[/b]! Days of fierce battles will end with four champions proudly taking their new thrones on [b]October 6th[/b].

You’ll be guided through the spectacle by the most beloved faces in the community, and you can catch the main event live on the Red Bull Gaming [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8VddvuHJzIj__Ud0rY2_ww]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/redbull/videos]Twitch[/url] channels. Whether you plan to witness the showdown from home or from the castle grounds, there will be plenty of action and activities for fans to enjoy.

Read the full announcement from [url=https://www.redbull.com/int-en/events/red-bull-wololo-el-reinado]Red Bull here[/url].
[quote][h2]Looking Back at Red Bull Wololo[/h2]
History trembles with the weight of legendary battles won and lost since the very first Red Bull Wololo tournament in 2020. Let us take a glance back through the ages and see how it all began.

[i]Spoilers below from the past Red Bull Wololo Tournaments![/i]

[h3]The First One[/h3]
[previewyoutube=8JWWUuMTnpo;full][/previewyoutube]
From the first spark of Red Bull Wololo, it was evident that we were witnessing something unique. The tournament was one of the first of its kind to utilise the newly added “Empire Wars” game mode, which allowed for more fast-paced and thrilling games, captivating audiences worldwide. With a prize pool of over $22,000.00, the competition was fierce. After an exhilarating grand final between TheViper and Mr_Yo, the first-ever Red Bull Wololo champion Mr_Yo was crowned.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo II[/h3]
[previewyoutube=C_TwCo4azhw;full][/previewyoutube]
It wasn’t long before the flames were reignited and Red Bull Wololo II was announced, but this time, the stakes were higher than ever with $30,000.00 on the line. The tournament proved that anything was possible – expectations and player seeding meant nothing in the level of competition we were witnessing. The games were sharper, the show was greater, and the competition was blazing with two new finalists. Liereyy and Hera both met in the grand final after fighting through the many challengers on their path, before ultimately Liereyy was crowned as the champion of Red Bull Wololo II.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo III[/h3]
[previewyoutube=R_lD3tnlhaE;full][/previewyoutube]
With Red Bull Wololo III, we saw the tournament format evolve. The thrill of group stages and nail-biting eliminations pushed the players to their limits. In an unforgettable final between DauT and Liereyy, expectations were deified and DauT snatched victory from one of the most highly-regarded players in [i]Age of Empires[/i].

[h3]Red Bull Wololo IV[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Z2JrGmekTQU;full][/previewyoutube]
Red Bull Wololo IV embraced the epic Viking spirit with a diverse set of themed maps; players were transported to a world of longships and brutal raids. Sixteen entered the fray, but only one could reign supreme. Yet, through the chaos, Hera and Liereyy met again. As the dust settled, through their undeniable dominance the Red Bull Wololo throne was reclaimed by Liereyy.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo: Enthrone[/h3]
[previewyoutube=2u3HupyXyKQ;full][/previewyoutube]
History changed forever with Red Bull Wololo: Enthrone, the fifth iteration of the event. The legendary Heidelberg Castle became the battleground for this breathtaking tournament. The Red Bull Wololo had outgrown its online roots and became a spectacle with players battling against each other face-to-face, in the confines of the castle walls. This was where TheViper challenged Liereyy for his crown, and after uncontested strategic brilliance, TheViper ascended, becoming our Red Bull Wololo champion.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo: Legacy[/h3]
[previewyoutube=c3Rztv3tlx0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=kskioX7oLX0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=8tVnLXrG-D4;full][/previewyoutube]
In 2022, another siege was on the horizon. Red Bull Wololo: Legacy, the sixth iteration. In a celebration of multiple games in the franchise, we witnessed a display of dominance across several titles, once more, in the grand Castle of Heidelberg. The roar of a first-ever live audience fueling the players of [i]Age of Empires[/i], [i]II[/i], and [i]IV[/i]. Chim Sẻ Đi Nắng, TaToH, and MarineLord, each a titan of their chosen title, emerged victorious.[/quote]
We hope you enjoyed this quick recap of past Red Bull Wololo events. You’ll be able to watch the upcoming Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado on the Red Bull Gaming [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8VddvuHJzIj__Ud0rY2_ww]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/redbull/videos]Twitch[/url] channels. We hope to see you there!

The next chapter for [i]Age of Empires II: DE[/i] will be the single player focused DLC [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], [b]coming March 14th[/b]. Introduced in today’s show by its Creator, Ramsey Abdulrahim, this DLC will be like no other we’ve made before for [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] features 19 epic scenarios. Your strategy and choices will decide your fate: will you emerge as the ultimate victor, or fall as the vanquished? You’ll play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne and more. Each scenario features professional voice acting, new music, achievement and the quality you’d expect from an official [i]Age of Empires[/i] scenario.

Showcasing Medusa, Pegasus and Cerberus from the Greek pantheon, Melinda took us through how each unit has been updated, given completely new art and even had gameplay tweaks that will intensify their strengths and unique powers making them even more important in your strategy. notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 100.2.31845.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/1e2c052f080e42dfa57e5c2683c60703578b7bff.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i] is receiving a pre-emptive update to ensure online features continue to function as intended and remain compatible with current and future server updates.
 
We are switching our API's domain to aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com. This domain change was already made for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], and is now coming to [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i].
 
We're also removing the requirement to perform a (platform) login to access the /community/ APIs.
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3][u]What does this mean for me?[/u][/h3]
If you're using any of the current APIs, you'll have to switch the domain for your services to aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com. The endpoints and arguments can remain the same. We'll update you if those change.

If you're currently using a login to access the /community/ APIs, you will no longer need to. This does mean that rate limiting will be done on a per-IP basis, rather than a per-user basis.

[h3][u]By when do we have to make this change?[/u][/h3]
The current domain will stay functional until at least January 31st.

As mentioned above, you will no longer have to log in to access community APIs.

[h3][u]What about the ageofempires.com APIs?[/u][/h3]
Those are managed by World's Edge and will be maintained as they are.

Inspired by the 1998 expansion for [i]Age of Empires[/i] “[i]The Rise of Rome[/i]”, the new [i]Return of Rome[/i] expansion delivers familiar and brand new content for both established and new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/240ca1483d47ed496565ad5a887abec0a25aa894.jpg[/img]
[i]Return of Rome[/i] is a completely new type of DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], bringing classic [i]Age of Empires[/i] gameplay, style and key experiences as a brand-new self-contained experience. When launching [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], simply select the [i]Return of Rome[/i] icon on the Main Menu to transition your game into the [i]Return of Rome[/i] DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/568eb192148e39b4272de34c021a59e22736c777.jpg[/img]
Purchasing [i]Return of Rome[/i] will also grant you access to the bonus Romans civilization while playing in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] mode. The Romans will begin as a civilization for single player and unranked lobbies, then graduate to ranked play in the near future.
[h2]New Civilization, New Campaigns, and New Game Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c29f243d049e9f66375ac380dca4113aa4be9f85.jpg[/img]
Included in [i]Return of Rome[/i] are all 16 original [i]Age of Empires[/i] civilizations from the Assyrians to the Yamato, allowing players to get to grips with the civilizations that started the [i]Age of Empires[/i] journey.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f040f39ea950ff1c4ce31cadf3256b3b82297861.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/39a0578aaaad976554587969577060b2c21ab737.png[/img][/url]
Joining the ranks as the newest ancient civilization will be the Lac Viet. The Lac Viet is a fast-paced archer civilization from ancient Southeast Asia that will be exclusive to [i]Return of Rome[/i].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/83ba5aa9adea86fd975b3defb6fc9e0e222a6ef0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a5a7ff4bae54562e685f36efc2febad7221e8a34.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1a36790b96c49e93743a667cfd0713fea7c4b2e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/06618eee7e4e73d02e3b11cb5715f03f2b7b4b2e.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1f036c983f97c91237dda4cf0a9d289b34af7133.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6d7f69d5a68c9396d82e2bdd7b051c8abd1b3f70.png[/img][/url]

With new missions to tackle and stories told through the familiar [i]AoE II: DE[/i] style, you’ll be able to live more moments from history.

The D3 Game Mode will challenge players with a new way to play. D3 is an homage to a fan favorite rule set, made popular in the [i]Age[/i] Vietnamese professional scene, that is now fully integrated into the game.  This rule set reduces rush tactics and allows players to start their early game more robustly, only allowing fighting with a single unit until entering the Bronze Age, ensuring players reach later Ages for equal battles.  This rule set also bans walls and towers, making for exciting match ups later in the game.

notes.title: Age of Empires IV is Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/e6049fd51cd3c8a0d5b4e9f6b5fa104274b0b149.png[/img]

Emma Bridle, Director of Customer Voice, World’s Edge 

The day is upon us, the sun has risen on a new Age. The whole team is so proud to announce that [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is now available on Steam.

This is the first new numbered [i]Age of Empires[/i] title in 16 years, and we’re honored to have added a chapter to this globally beloved franchise. Players all over the world have been engaging in fierce battles, building expansive empires, and wololo-ing for close to 25 years and it’s thrilling to give our players more to enjoy.  

To celebrate the launch of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], we are taking over Times Square in NYC by spanning multiple city blocks of large digital screens, a living diorama, and an AR experience. Please share your experiences if you happen to be in NYC. For those in London, heading to Piccadilly Circus from November 2nd could be an experience for the ages. 

[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] has something for every strategy gaming fan. With eight diverse civilizations, four captivating campaigns, multiplayer, skirmish, maps, unlockable videos, Art of War challenges, masteries and more, we’re excited to see what you play first.  

If you’re new to [i]Age of Empires[/i]: first of all, welcome! Now that you’re with us, there’s plenty of ways for you to get started:  

[list]
[*] Head to the “Learn” tab in the opening menu to find our Intro Tutorial. Our narrator will guide you through the game’s foundational skills, like building your economy and entering combat, whilst you help a group of displaced villagers start anew.[/*]
[*] Got the basics down? Our “Art of War” challenges, found in Single Player, will help you refine skills and earn medals as you improve on the expertise needed to be victorious in future battles.[/*] 
[*] You can also play our campaigns via “Story Mode,” allowing you to enjoy the challenges of the game, but with reduced difficulty as you focus on the historical journey and gameplay.[/*] 
[*] You could also face up against the AI in “Skirmish” mode. Choose your civ, your AI difficulty, your map and ready up![/*] 
[*] Looking to test your mettle against other players? Jump into multiplayer and select “Quick Match” or create a Custom Game. How you play is up to you! From maps to win conditions, no game will be the same.[/*]
[*] We’ve also provided a breakdown of the hotkeys here on [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2021/10/22/age-of-empires-iv-hotkeys-revealed/]Xbox Wire for easy reference.[/url][/*]  
[/list]If this isn’t your first voyage onto the battlefield, there’s plenty of new features for you to enjoy in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Try positioning your archers on top of walls to literally take your strategy to new heights. Place your units in stealth forests to ready the perfect ambush, your units will even whisper to evade discovery by your enemies. Move your entire civilization across the map whilst playing as the Mongols and choose your landmarks to age up and gain additional bonuses.  

There’s so much to enjoy with [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] and we can’t wait to hear from you as you get started. The team is ready and waiting to hear your feedback! Need support? Head to our dedicated Support Site to get you back to battle. 

Wololo!

notes.notes:
Age of Empires 4 launches autumn 2021. It'll be available on PC via Steam and the Windows Store, and will be available day one on Xbox Game Pass for PC.

The real-time strategy sequel includes a Norman campaign - one of four historic campaigns in the game at launch. Gameplay is in the video below (there's a naval combat tease at the end):

There's a new presentation style for Age of Empire 4's campaigns that draws inspiration from gilded manuscripts of the time. The "golden soldiers" project historical events over present-day real-world locations and aim to provide a realistic sense of place in how events unfolded hundreds of years ago. Microsoft said it's all very BBC documentary.

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition — Update 46777
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/6063553bbe35d86fb4c6832bbb1081c504393157.png[/img]

Hello warriors of rogan, priests of the almighty wololo, and masters of the ancient world!

Today, we’re excited to package up a long-awaited delivery of bug fixes and balance changes for you to enjoy in[i] Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]. This full change log is short enough to skip a tl;dr version, but it’s worth noting that the main focus of this month’s release is on the playability of the game and spectating experience. Check out the full notes, below!

We fully recognize that there is more you’d like to see from [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i], and we’ve already captured some of the most prominent discussion points for future consideration. Your voices have been key in identifying the fixes and features we’ll be working on for the game, and we want to continue encouraging you to use your voice! Whether you’d like to see gameplay improvements, new features, or have a list ready to go, we want to hear about them over on our official channels.

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We hope you enjoy today’s release, and look forward to hearing more about what you’d like to see in [i]Age: DE[/i].

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team


[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 46777 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where game chat sent to ALL players (using “[b]*[/b]“) would not be visible for Player 8.
[*] Fixed several problems with the presentation of the [b]Statistics – Timeline[/b].
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] [b]Ruins[/b] and [b]Artifacts[/b] can no longer be moved using the [b]Shift + Delete[/b] key.
[*] Fixed remaining instances where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall by placing their production building adjacent to the wall.
[*] Fixed several pathfinding bugs which would cause units to occasionally get stuck in each other’s models.
[*] Fixed an issue where using [b]Stand Ground[/b] and [b]Attack Move[/b] could cause units be stuck in one location while playing their attack animation.
[*] Fixed some equally-odd behaviors when setting a unit to [b]Defensive Stance[/b] and issuing an [b]Attack Move[/b] command.
[*] Units set to [b]Stand Ground[/b] will now chase targeted units when manually tasked to attack them.
[*] Units set to [b]Defensive Stance[/b] will no longer return to their previous location when manually tasked to attack a unit or building.
[*] Using the [b]Shift + Delete[/b] command to cancel unfinished buildings will now properly refund their cost.
[*] Changing a unit’s stance to [b]No Attack[/b] will now properly interrupt the unit’s current attack.
[*] Implemented countermeasures for numerous cheat exploits.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ballista:[/b] Increased attack speed by [b]+15%[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reverted [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1017900/view/2542794099151308137]previous changes[/url] to damage by increasing it from [b]5 ▶ 6[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Increased gold cost from [b]45 ▶ 60 gold[/b], which restores the original game value. The food cost remains the same (180 food).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Reduced the upgrade cost from [b]1500 ▶ 1200 food[/b]. The wood cost remains the same (1000 wood).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased attack from [b]40 ▶ 45[/b].
[*] [b]Legion:[/b] Reduced health from [b]160 ▶ 140[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Long Sword:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]160 food, 50 gold ▶ 240 food, 100 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Assyrians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Alchemy:[/b] Now have access to the technology!
[/list]
[h3][b]Babylonians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
The Babylonians now have access to all [b]Chain Mail[/b] technologies. This includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Archers[/b]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Cavalry[/b]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Infantry[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Shang[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ballistics:[/b] Now have access to the technology!
[/list]

[h1][b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the [b]Solid Farms[/b] setting to default to [b]“On”[/b] for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Team Together[/b] option might fail to place players in the proper positions while spectators were also present in the game.
[/list]
[h3][b]Spectating[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an indicator next to the player names in the scoreboard and selection panel denoting which player you are currently spectating.
[/list]
The spectator hotkeys, [b]1-8[/b], will now correspond to the [b]Player Colors[/b]. This means that:
[list]
[*] Pressing [b]1[/b] will always display the resources and global queue of the [b]Blue[/b] player
[*] Pressing [b]2[/b] will display the resources and global queue of the [b]Red[/b] player
[*] [b]3 = Yellow[/b]
[*] [b]4 = Brown[/b]
[*] [b]5 = Orange[/b]
[*] [b]6 = Green[/b]
[*] [b]7 = Magenta[/b]
[*] [b]8 = Cyan[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Updated game strings to reflect all balance changes made over the last several updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the new Age of Empires Support Site!
notes.notes:
The Age of Empires team is THRILLED to introduce you to the brand-new [i]Age of Empires[/i] Support Site! This is your one-stop shop when you’re having problems downloading, running, or playing the Definitive Edition games—whether you’re looking for solutions to common problems, workarounds for technical issues, information about known issues, or need help from one of our friendly support agents!

[code][h3][url=https://support.ageofempires.com][b]🛠 support.ageofempires.com[/b][/url][/h3][/code]
[h1]Have a Problem?[/h1]
Whenever you encounter an issue in one of your games, start by [b]searching the knowledgebase[/b] for answers and solutions to the most common problems!

[url=https://support.ageofempires.com/][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/kb-homepage-1080x518.jpg[/img][/url]

Here’s how to get started:
[list][*] [b]If you want to search by game,[/b] click an image to jump straight to the list of articles about that game!
[*] [b]Don’t know where to begin?[/b] Use the [b]Search[/b] field to see what articles already exist about your issue.
[*] [b]Can’t find a solution to your issue?[/b] We’ve got you covered; contact our awesome support team (see below) so they can help you out![/list]
As new issues (and solutions) are discovered, the support site will continue to evolve and cater to our players' needs. [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/]Check back [/url] whenever you encounter an issue in a game!

[h1]We’re Here to Help![/h1]
If you’re unable to find a solution or workaround to your issue on the support site, a dedicated team of [i]Age of Empires[/i] support agents can help you find a solution! There are several types of requests you can submit:
[list][*] Forum & Website Issues
[*] Insider Support
[*] Download & Installation Issues
[*] Game Crash
[*] Report a Player
[*] Ban Inquiry
[*] General Questions
[*] [i]…and more![/i][/list]
At the bottom of each article, you’ll see a link to [b][url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/requests/new]Submit a request[/url][/b]; use this to open a support ticket directly with our team, who will contact you via email to help you troubleshoot your problem! When submitting a ticket, here are a few tips to keep in mind that will help the team help you as quickly as possible:
[list][*] [b]Fill out EVERY field![/b] Fill out all available fields to ensure that we have everything we need to assist you.
[*] [b]Be descriptive![/b] Don’t hold back when describing the problem you’re experiencing. Try to highlight when it happened, what might have caused it, what you experienced, and any information that might be helpful for the team.
[*] [b]Attach your dxdiag![/b] Especially if you’re experiencing a technical problem, your [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049024411]dxdiag file[/url] can provide some valuable insight into the root cause of the problem.
[*] [b]Include screenshots and logs![/b] A picture can be worth a thousand words, and crash logs can provide much-needed insight into the issue. Attach any files you think will be helpful![/list]
Once you’ve filled out the ticket fields, hit the [b]Submit[/b] button and a support agent will get back to you as soon as possible!

[h1]Or Ask the Community[/h1]
While our agents work to answer questions and expand the knowledgebase, the community is also a wonderful resource for quick answers and troubleshooting steps! If you feel more comfortable asking questions, you can still visit the official forum and Discord to ask for help:
[list][*] [b][url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]Age of Empires on Discord[/url][/b]
[*] [b][url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/]Age of Empires Official Forum[/url][/b]
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions/]Age of Empires Steam Forum[/url][/b][/list]
Above all else, we want everyone to enjoy their favorite [i]Age of Empires[/i] games by removing the hurdles that stop you from doing so! Come visit the site and let us know if there’s anything we can do to help you enjoy your favorite [i]Age of Empires[/i] game!

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition — Update 38862
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/292d89efd1c9cfa717b83420bc747dc581d10034.png[/img]

IT’S HERE! [i]Age of Empires[/i] fans rejoice: a new update and new ways to play Age are upon us! The Priests are here to spread the word, and everyone can chant along to the [i]♪ wolooolooooo ♪[/i].

Today’s release comes with a huge list of changes for the classic RTS title: including a boatload of balance adjustments, improvements to many of your favorite civilizations, the return of several features from the classic [i]Age of Empires[/i] experience, and several brand-new systems to continue the ongoing evolution of the game! Here are some of the highlights:
[list][*] [b]New unit stances![/b]
[*] [b]New & improved matchmaking lobby: new chat shortcuts, mirrored civilization picks, and more![/b]
[*] [b]Reorganized ranked ladders (paired with a ladder reset)![/b]
[*] [b]Balance updates to maps, units, and civilizations![/b]
[*] [b]Reduced install size from ~17GB to ~12GB![/b]
[*] [b]Anti-cheat improvements![/b]
[*] [i]...and more![/i][/list]
As always, we want to hear about your experience as you jump into Update 38862! Be sure to visit our official channels to talk with the team and become a part of the community!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/eventcomments/]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 38862 Discussion[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Enjoy the latest update and as always: keep those Wonders building!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 38862 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ NEW CONTENT & FEATURES ◆[/h1][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_unit_stances.png[/img]
[list][*] New [b]unit stances[/b] are available—similar to those in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.
[list][*] Aggressive (Default)
[*] Defensive
[*] Stand Ground
[*] No Attack[/list]
[*] A new [b]Mirror Civilization[/b] option is available in multiplayer lobbies, allowing you to match the civilization of your opponent.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_solid_farms-1080x508.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Added a new [b]Solid Farms (Legacy)[/b] setting. When enabled, farms act as solid buildings (like the original game) that block movement until the farm is destroyed.
[*] New hotkeys have been added to support the following actions:
[list][*] Select all buildings of the same type (Ctrl + Shift + key)
[*] Select all idle villagers [Ctrl + Shift + .]
[*] Select all military units [Ctrl + Shift + ,]
[*] Delete all selected units [Shift + Delete]
[*] Reset zoom to default level (100%) [Ctrl + Alt + 0][/list]
[*] Implemented several new [b]anti-cheat[/b] measures to keep things honest and fair![/list]
[h1]◆ MULTIPLAYER ◆[/h1]
[list][*] The [b]Team[/b] ranked lobby option is no longer locked and can be used to create 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 matches.
[*] Quickmatch and ranked lobbies now share the same Elo ladders.
[*] Elo ladders are now split into [b]1v1[/b] and [b]Team[/b] ladders for both the [b]Random Map[/b] and [b]Deathmatch[/b] ranked modes. Quickmatch is still divided into 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4, but the latter three (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) count towards your [b]Team[/b] Elo.
[*] Leaderboards will now display the Elo values for all players.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_leaderboards-1080x608.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Ranked games should no longer end up with unevenly-distributed teams.
[*] Options used when creating a ranked lobby will no longer remain as a filter following the game.
[*] The default team for both the host and clients in a lobby is now set to [b]random[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug that caused random teams to create unbalanced teams.
[*] Players will no longer be un-readied when another player in the lobby changes their team or color.
[*] Lobby chat can now be scrolled using the mouse wheel.
[*] Updated the message when kicking someone from a lobby to properly display the player's name.
[*] Added a new countdown before a match begins.
[*] Added chat shortcuts to send a message to specific players within a match: [b]Allies[/b] (;), [b]Enemies[/b] (#), and [b]All[/b] (*)
[*] Chat will no longer be displayed for the enemy team when co-op players are in a match.
[*] Chat will no longer break after displaying a multi-line message.
[*] Spectators can now see player resources and the global queue for each player by using the number keys (1-8).[/list]
[h1]◆ GAME ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an uncommon issue that caused some users to disconnect approximately 5 minutes after starting a match.
[*] Implemented general performance optimizations.[/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an unintended mechanic where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall built next to the production building.
[*] Units will no longer be created from blocked buildings that have no valid space for the unit to spawn.
[*] Military units will no longer lose their collision boxes or stack/merge together when grouped closely or forced into a tight space.
[*] Fixed rare instances where [b]Ballistics[/b] would fail to properly improve the accuracy of the Catapult Trireme or Juggernaught.
[*] Using [b]Attack Move[/b] with [b]Priests[/b] in the selection group will no longer inspire them to try and convert enemy units who enter their line of sight.
[*] Villagers will no longer automatically hunt another nearby Elephant after gathering all the food from the first.
[*] Naval units will no longer get stuck in Docks where they are created.
[*] Left-clicking to execute a command will now work even when moving the cursor while clicking.
[*] Implemented global pathfinding improvements.[/list]
[h3][b]GRAPHICS[/b][/h3][list][*] Graphics assets now use a compressed format in order to reduce the overall size of the game and new updates.
[list][*] Implemented additional installation optimizations to reduce the hard drive space required by the game.
[*] [b]NOTE:[/b] These changes will require an (initially) larger download than normal to download the new files. This will reduce the size of future downloads.[/list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of certain unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] The selection outlines for units and buildings are not properly scaled at all zoom levels.
[*] Implemented minor changes to some unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] Slowed the destruction animations of buildings to more reasonable levels.
[*] Units now decay and disappear from the battlefield more rapidly.[/list]
[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*] Adjusted in-game sounds to a more consistent volume level.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the maximum zoom threshold in multiplayer to match that of single player.
[*] Renamed the [b]Black Map Fog[/b] option to [b]Animate Fog[/b] in order to better clarify its purpose.
[*] Players are now sorted by Team on the [b]Statistics - Timeline[/b] screen.[/list]
[h1]◆ CIVILIZATION BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3][list][*] Villagers now move [b]10%[/b] faster in the Tool Age. The [b]Wheel[/b] technology now grants a [b]+50%[/b] speed boost (was +60%) to maintain the same maximum speed.
[*] [b]Warships[/b] and [b]Slingers[/b] no longer deal a minimum of 1 damage to buildings. This reduces the damage dealt by Slingers against normal buildings and by Scout Ships against walls and towers.
[*] Decreased the maximum search radius of [b]Priests[/b] to prevent them from fixating on and following distant injured units.
[*] Predator animals will no longer break off their attack if you try to drop a building on them.
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Now have [b]+20 hp[/b], [b]+1 armor[/b], and [b]+2 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 7).
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Reduced the gold cost of the upgrade from [b]750[/b] to [b]600 gold[/b]. The food cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Domestication:[/b] Reduced the food cost to research the technology from [b]200[/b] to [b]150 food[/b]. The wood cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Heavy Cavalry:[/b] Now have [b]+1 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 6).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased the fire rate by [b]5%[/b] (still slower than that in the original game).
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Increased cost from [b]80[/b] to [b]90 food[/b]. (This is still lower than the 100 food cost in the original game.)
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Reduced line of sight by [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Reduced armor from [b]2[/b] to [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]1200 wood, 800 gold[/b] to [b]1400 wood, 1000 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the time to research the unit from [b]150[/b] to [b]200 seconds[/b].
[*] Chariot units no longer deal bonus damage to Priests.
[*] Reduced the conversion resistance of all Chariot units from [b]8x[/b] to [b]2x[/b] that of normal units.
[*] [b]Siegecraft:[/b] Reduced the attack bonus granted to Villagers vs. towers and walls by ~50%.
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]28[/b] to [b]35 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Reduced damage dealt to walls and towers by ~50%.
[*] Towers: Increased the hp of all towers: Watch Tower (+25 hp), Sentry Tower (+35 hp), Guard Tower (+40 hp), Ballista Tower (+40 hp).[/list]
Several units and technologies have had attributes adjusted to match their original game values:
[list][*] [b]Bowman:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]26[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Coinage:[/b] Increased the amount of bonus gold yielded from nodes from [b]+10%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b].
[*] [b]Camel Rider:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]32[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reduced attack damage from [b]6[/b] to [b]5[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]BABYLONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Market technologies are 30% cheaper to research.
[*] Decreased the bonus hp of walls and towers from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]CARTHAGINIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Carthaginians now start the game with [b]+50[/b] of each resource.[/list]
[h3][b]CHOSON[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Storage Pit technologies are [b]40%[/b] cheaper to research.[/list]
[h3][b]EGYPTIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Farms are 20% cheaper to build; they now cost [b]60 wood[/b] instead of [b]75 wood[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]GREEK[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Town Centers work 10% faster starting in the Tool Age. This affects both Villager creation and aging up.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Fire Galley[/b] naval unit.[/list]
[h3][b]HITTITES[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +3 range at all times, Hittite warships now have [b]+2 range[/b] in the Tool Age and [b]+3 range[/b] in the Bronze and Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]MACEDONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +2 pierce armor at all times, Macedonian Academy units now have [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Bronze Age and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b] in the Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]PALMYRANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the civilization starting food bonus from [b]+50[/b] to [b]+75 food[/b].
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]PERSIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the movement speed of Persian Elephant units from [b]+20%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b] that of other elephants.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]ROMANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Tower costs from [b]-50%[/b] to [b]-40%[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]SHANG[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Wall hp from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]YAMATO[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Cavalry unit costs from [b]-20%[/b] to [b]-15%[/b].
[*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Ship hp from [b]+25%[/b] to [b]+20% hp[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ MAP BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Increased the quantity of gold in node tiles from [b]400[/b] to [b]450 gold[/b].
[*] Increased the quantity of stone in node tiles from [b]250[/b] to [b]300 stone[/b].
[*] Maps now guarantee that one straggler tree spawns near the Town Center of each player on all maps. Additional straggler trees are random, as before.
[*] Increased the amount of gold generated on maps. Most maps now have [b]3[/b] piles of gold per player except for the Continental and Narrows maps, which have [b]2[/b] larger piles.
[*] Adjusted how maps are generated to ensure that the same amount of gold and stone spawns in each pile for each player.
[*] Lions will no longer spawn in pairs. There is still a small chance for two lions to spawn relatively close to each other, but that's entirely random.
[*] [b]Continental:[/b] Slightly increased the forested area.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Increased the amount of forest that spawns on the island.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Non-player gold nodes have been replaced with another player gold.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the size of the islands.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the number of resources that spawn on each island, as well as shore fish and deep sea fish.
[*] [b]Oasis:[/b] Reduced the amount of water and increased the amount of forest spawned at the center of the map.
[*] Other minor map improvements.[/list]

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 38862 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ NEW CONTENT & FEATURES ◆[/h1][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_unit_stances.png[/img]
[list][*] New [b]unit stances[/b] are available—similar to those in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.
[list][*] Aggressive (Default)
[*] Defensive
[*] Stand Ground
[*] No Attack[/list]
[*] A new [b]Mirror Civilization[/b] option is available in multiplayer lobbies, allowing you to match the civilization of your opponent.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_solid_farms-1080x508.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Added a new [b]Solid Farms (Legacy)[/b] setting. When enabled, farms act as solid buildings (like the original game) that block movement until the farm is destroyed.
[*] New hotkeys have been added to support the following actions:
[list][*] Select all buildings of the same type (Ctrl + Shift + key)
[*] Select all idle villagers [Ctrl + Shift + .]
[*] Select all military units [Ctrl + Shift + ,]
[*] Delete all selected units [Shift + Delete]
[*] Reset zoom to default level (100%) [Ctrl + Alt + 0][/list]
[*] Implemented several new [b]anti-cheat[/b] measures to keep things honest and fair![/list]
[h1]◆ MULTIPLAYER ◆[/h1]
[list][*] The [b]Team[/b] ranked lobby option is no longer locked and can be used to create 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 matches.
[*] Quickmatch and ranked lobbies now share the same Elo ladders.
[*] Elo ladders are now split into [b]1v1[/b] and [b]Team[/b] ladders for both the [b]Random Map[/b] and [b]Deathmatch[/b] ranked modes. Quickmatch is still divided into 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4, but the latter three (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) count towards your [b]Team[/b] Elo.
[*] Leaderboards will now display the Elo values for all players.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_leaderboards-1080x608.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Ranked games should no longer end up with unevenly-distributed teams.
[*] Options used when creating a ranked lobby will no longer remain as a filter following the game.
[*] The default team for both the host and clients in a lobby is now set to [b]random[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug that caused random teams to create unbalanced teams.
[*] Players will no longer be un-readied when another player in the lobby changes their team or color.
[*] Lobby chat can now be scrolled using the mouse wheel.
[*] Updated the message when kicking someone from a lobby to properly display the player's name.
[*] Added a new countdown before a match begins.
[*] Added chat shortcuts to send a message to specific players within a match: [b]Allies[/b] (;), [b]Enemies[/b] (#), and [b]All[/b] (*)
[*] Chat will no longer be displayed for the enemy team when co-op players are in a match.
[*] Chat will no longer break after displaying a multi-line message.
[*] Spectators can now see player resources and the global queue for each player by using the number keys (1-8).[/list]
[h1]◆ GAME ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an uncommon issue that caused some users to disconnect approximately 5 minutes after starting a match.
[*] Implemented general performance optimizations.[/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an unintended mechanic where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall built next to the production building.
[*] Units will no longer be created from blocked buildings that have no valid space for the unit to spawn.
[*] Military units will no longer lose their collision boxes or stack/merge together when grouped closely or forced into a tight space.
[*] Fixed rare instances where [b]Ballistics[/b] would fail to properly improve the accuracy of the Catapult Trireme or Juggernaught.
[*] Using [b]Attack Move[/b] with [b]Priests[/b] in the selection group will no longer inspire them to try and convert enemy units who enter their line of sight.
[*] Villagers will no longer automatically hunt another nearby Elephant after gathering all the food from the first.
[*] Naval units will no longer get stuck in Docks where they are created.
[*] Left-clicking to execute a command will now work even when moving the cursor while clicking.
[*] Implemented global pathfinding improvements.[/list]
[h3][b]GRAPHICS[/b][/h3][list][*] Graphics assets now use a compressed format in order to reduce the overall size of the game and new updates.
[list][*] Implemented additional installation optimizations to reduce the hard drive space required by the game.
[*] [b]NOTE:[/b] These changes will require an (initially) larger download than normal to download the new files. This will reduce the size of future downloads.[/list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of certain unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] The selection outlines for units and buildings are not properly scaled at all zoom levels.
[*] Implemented minor changes to some unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] Slowed the destruction animations of buildings to more reasonable levels.
[*] Units now decay and disappear from the battlefield more rapidly.[/list]
[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*] Adjusted in-game sounds to a more consistent volume level.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the maximum zoom threshold in multiplayer to match that of single player.
[*] Renamed the [b]Black Map Fog[/b] option to [b]Animate Fog[/b] in order to better clarify its purpose.
[*] Players are now sorted by Team on the [b]Statistics - Timeline[/b] screen.[/list]
[h1]◆ CIVILIZATION BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3][list][*] Villagers now move [b]10%[/b] faster in the Tool Age. The [b]Wheel[/b] technology now grants a [b]+50%[/b] speed boost (was +60%) to maintain the same maximum speed.
[*] [b]Warships[/b] and [b]Slingers[/b] no longer deal a minimum of 1 damage to buildings. This reduces the damage dealt by Slingers against normal buildings and by Scout Ships against walls and towers.
[*] Decreased the maximum search radius of [b]Priests[/b] to prevent them from fixating on and following distant injured units.
[*] Predator animals will no longer break off their attack if you try to drop a building on them.
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Now have [b]+20 hp[/b], [b]+1 armor[/b], and [b]+2 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 7).
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Reduced the gold cost of the upgrade from [b]750[/b] to [b]600 gold[/b]. The food cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Domestication:[/b] Reduced the food cost to research the technology from [b]200[/b] to [b]150 food[/b]. The wood cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Heavy Cavalry:[/b] Now have [b]+1 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 6).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased the fire rate by [b]5%[/b] (still slower than that in the original game).
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Increased cost from [b]80[/b] to [b]90 food[/b]. (This is still lower than the 100 food cost in the original game.)
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Reduced line of sight by [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Reduced armor from [b]2[/b] to [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]1200 wood, 800 gold[/b] to [b]1400 wood, 1000 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the time to research the unit from [b]150[/b] to [b]200 seconds[/b].
[*] Chariot units no longer deal bonus damage to Priests.
[*] Reduced the conversion resistance of all Chariot units from [b]8x[/b] to [b]2x[/b] that of normal units.
[*] [b]Siegecraft:[/b] Reduced the attack bonus granted to Villagers vs. towers and walls by ~50%.
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]28[/b] to [b]35 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Reduced damage dealt to walls and towers by ~50%.
[*] Towers: Increased the hp of all towers: Watch Tower (+25 hp), Sentry Tower (+35 hp), Guard Tower (+40 hp), Ballista Tower (+40 hp).[/list]
Several units and technologies have had attributes adjusted to match their original game values:
[list][*] [b]Bowman:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]26[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Coinage:[/b] Increased the amount of bonus gold yielded from nodes from [b]+10%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b].
[*] [b]Camel Rider:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]32[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reduced attack damage from [b]6[/b] to [b]5[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]BABYLONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Market technologies are 30% cheaper to research.
[*] Decreased the bonus hp of walls and towers from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]CARTHAGINIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Carthaginians now start the game with [b]+50[/b] of each resource.[/list]
[h3][b]CHOSON[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Storage Pit technologies are [b]40%[/b] cheaper to research.[/list]
[h3][b]EGYPTIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Farms are 20% cheaper to build; they now cost [b]60 wood[/b] instead of [b]75 wood[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]GREEK[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Town Centers work 10% faster stating in the Tool Age. This affects both Villager creation and aging up.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Fire Galley[/b] naval unit.[/list]
[h3][b]HITTITES[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +3 range at all times, Hittite warships now have [b]+2 range[/b] in the Tool Age and [b]+3 range[/b] in the Bronze and Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]MACEDONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +2 pierce armor at all times, Macedonian Academy units now have [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Bronze Age and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b] in the Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]PALMYRANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the civilization starting food bonus from [b]+50[/b] to [b]+75 food[/b].
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]PERSIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the movement speed of Persian Elephant units from [b]+20%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b] that of other elephants.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]ROMANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Tower costs from [b]-50%[/b] to [b]-40%[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]SHANG[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Wall hp from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]YAMATO[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Cavalry unit costs from [b]-20%[/b] to [b]-15%[/b].
[*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Ship hp from [b]+25%[/b] to [b]+20% hp[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ MAP BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Increased the quantity of gold in node tiles from [b]400[/b] to [b]450 gold[/b].
[*] Increased the quantity of stone in node tiles from [b]250[/b] to [b]300 stone[/b].
[*] Maps now guarantee that one straggler tree spawns near the Town Center of each player on all maps. Additional straggler trees are random, as before.
[*] Increased the amount of gold generated on maps. Most maps now have [b]3[/b] piles of gold per player except for the Continental and Narrows maps, which have [b]2[/b] larger piles.
[*] Adjusted how maps are generated to ensure that the same amount of gold and stone spawns in each pile for each player.
[*] Lions will no longer spawn in pairs. There is still a small chance for two lions to spawn relatively close to each other, but that's entirely random.
[*] [b]Continental:[/b] Slightly increased the forested area.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Increased the amount of forest that spawns on the island.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Non-player gold nodes have been replaced with another player gold.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the size of the islands.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the number of resources that spawn on each island, as well as shore fish and deep sea fish.
[*] [b]Oasis:[/b] Reduced the amount of water and increased the amount of forest spawned at the center of the map.
[*] Other minor map improvements.[/list]
